description: This file defines the Sort class within the Drupal JSON:API module, responsible for handling and parsing the 'sort' query parameter for API requests, including expansion of string-based sort specifications into structured arrays, and validation of sort parameters.

classes.name: Drupal\jsonapi\Query\Sort
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and parsing the 'sort' parameter in JSON:API requests, including expansion and validation of sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Sort object with an array of sort fields.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns the array of sort fields.

methods.name: createFromQueryParameter
methods.description: Creates a Sort object from a query parameter, expanding string inputs and applying defaults.

methods.name: expandFieldString
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated string of fields into an array of sort specifications, handling direction indicators.

methods.name: expandItem
methods.description: Expands a sort item, validating required keys and applying defaults.
